stages.name: outlet_listed
stages.note: the outlet's card must be in the Town registry, verified

stages.name: outlet_discovered
stages.note: every reader must find the outlet through the registry

stages.name: package_verified[reader-subscriber]
stages.note: every answer to a subscriber's reader must be a completed task with a matching package of at least one sentence, whose id and signature check out under the key on the outlet's Town card

stages.name: sentences_match_published_story[reader-subscriber]
stages.note: the published story could not be compared

stages.name: no_package_without_credential[reader-stranger]
stages.note: a reader with no subscriber credential must get a completed answer and no package

stages.name: ledger_conserved
stages.note: complete run recorded no money moved
